svg.title: CCR5 delta32 sequence and shifted reading frame
svg.desc: Exact source DNA for wildtype residues 171 through 230. Thirty-two bases highlighted in red are deleted. Mutant frame begins at amino acid 185 and terminates after residue 215. Full-length wildtype has 352 amino acids.

g.text: Δ32: shared residues 171-184; new frame starts at 185
Wildtype continues for 122 additional amino acids beyond residue 230 (352 total).
